citations.assessment: The Bavli names the son, the ordination and Shimon ben Isi ben Lakonya, maternal uncle. The spelling bar in Heilprin is retained.
The academy and the attempted burial are successive episodes. The checked Bavli expressly introduces the cave at his death.
This passage attributes the fenced-vineyard comparison to Yose be-Rabbi Elazar in Rabban Gamliel’s name, separately from plain Yose’s comparison.
The earlier entry gives the separate analogy of a woman and directs readers back to Yose be-Rabbi Elazar.
